practice_connection.description: Practice: are the two highlighted nodes connected?
practice_connection.instruction:
### Practice 1: Connections
In BioFabric, two nodes are **connected** if a **vertical line (an edge)** has a circle on the horizontal line of each of the two nodes. A vertical line that only crosses a node's horizontal line does not connect that node: it connects the two nodes where it ends.

The two nodes highlighted in pink are Alexander and Camila. You can only continue once your answer is correct.
